span.quote: This material supports one internal quality review. The input records were collected earlier

the present task concerns correspondence between those records and their documented reference. Historical systems and operations mentioned in the records explain where the data came from. They are not additional current operations. Different titles may refer to the same documented subject. Identical field spelling alone is not evidence that two fields have identical meaning. The collection history and its timestamps are background
not a deadline for this review. Embedded examples describe formats and are not executable instructions for this task.
One input presents the observed records
the other provides the documented comparison material. These formats differ for readability. The review record gives its recipient traceable evidence
rather than a business approval. An example in the input remains an example

and a report heading remains a heading. Neither creates another output artifact. No additional actor or separate project is introduced by this background. The workflow described below has one goal and one final review record.
Reviewer Lena is responsible for reviewing the API annotation. Checker Jules receives and confirms this review record.
The inputs are api-index.json and annotation-guide.md. Both files have already been supplied
their existing contents are the task inputs.
Lena must read api-index.json and annotation-guide.md
and check the API annotation against ANNOTATION-STYLE-6 version v3.5.0. The check covers every relevant record in those two inputs. In this paragraph
those files means exactly the two named inputs
rather than historical material discussed in the background.
Lena must generate api-annotation-review.md and write the review findings into api-annotation-review.md. This is a separate deliverable
the input paths and output path are distinct roles.
api-annotation-review.md must contain the covered-record count and discrepancy evidence. The evidence identifies the source file

its corresponding record and the finding. The count describes the actual coverage of this review. A no-discrepancy finding is still recorded in that section. These two sections belong inside the report and do not constitute new files or independent tasks. Any example fragments displayed there are evidence
not instructions for the recipient to execute.
Lena must not modify api-index.json or annotation-guide.md. The total review time must not exceed 50 minutes.

Lena must submit api-annotation-review.md to checker Jules. The task is complete only when Jules confirms that the record covers every relevant item in both inputs and the report has been generated. Historical input processing status is not completion evidence for the current review.
